0022600204.text: The Charlotte Hornets, 3-7 and on a six-game losing streak, host the Cleveland Cavaliers, who are 5-5 and 7th in the East, in the Hornets' 11th game of the season. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Charlotte lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 118-113 loss in Charlotte on February 20, 2026. Charlotte is without Dennis Schroder (thigh), Grant Williams (hamstring) and Kon Knueppel (hamstring strain), with Brandon Miller (groin soreness) and Moussa Diabate (quadriceps) listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions, while Cleveland is without Jarrett Allen (knee), Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain) and Sam Merrill (elbow).
